requirements: Unknown original order IDs must not be lost across process restart
Same-wallet signing and original-ID queries only, no resubmission
Frozen ordinary/conditional/trailing/entire/attached query terms and batch sent-item boundaries
native_testing: Skipped at user request. No device tools, process-kill/device tests or APK installation. Host filesystem reconstruction tests are not native verification. See ../native-verification-pending.md.
ios: Linux has no macOS/Xcode; build and native flows unverified.
implementation: main loads and injects a file journal from the native application support directory before rendering. Failures remain blocking, never silently replaced by an empty memory journal.

Only public original ID, address, symbol, frozen query terms, mode, original attached protection quantity and record time are persisted; no balances, signed request bytes, nonce, signature, token, key or actionable preflight context.

After wallet signature and before POST, write, flush and atomically rename the pending record on the same filesystem. Revalidate confirmation after disk I/O. Persistence failure prevents POST; interrupted pre-send records remain unknown for GET-only review.

Versioned strict serialization rejects unknown fields, invalid scope/flags/enums/decimals, duplicate IDs and oversized UTF-8 bytes. Serial read-modify-write preserves other-wallet records and prevents overwriting current-wallet pending entries.

Only a matching signed ordinary/strategy query deletes the matching durable record. Missing, malformed, refused or timed-out queries retain it; completed-record removal failure retains both the verified response and a blocking storage error.
Recovery controller/repository is GET-only. Original symbol/origClientOrderId or clientStrategyId/type and existing strict mappers retained, including strategy same-ID history fallback on -2013.

Current-wallet pending entries block new order/configuration leases; explicit original-ID queries remain available. Records are isolated by wallet and survive logout/reconnect, while late callbacks are discarded on identity change.
Toolbar count and recovery page, explicit reconnect, copyable identifiers, local record time, loading/error/retry/empty/verified states and blocking notices on order/quick/config/batch routes.
Batch recovery contains only sent items, never resumes unsubmitted queue items. Ordinary/quick/conditional/trailing/entire/close and attached strategy writers use the same persistence boundary.

Tests cover filesystem reconstruction, failed writes/deletes, corrupted canonical files, interrupted temp file, duplicate/scope checks, UTF-8 size budget, after-signature expiry, GET-only recovery, strict query mismatches and Chinese/English 320 width with 1.5 text scaling and landscape.
boundaries: No real-device process-kill, background reclamation, filesystem fault, power-loss durability or native wallet reconnect was verified. flush and rename do not prove device/power-loss behavior.
Recovery applies only to entries recorded after this version is used. Uninstall, cleared app data or device loss removes local records. Exchange query retention windows still apply.
An unfound original query never proves non-submission and does not automatically clear its block. No automatic retry POST or manual assume-failed action exists.
This is unresolved order/strategy recovery, not a complete cross-session accepted-strategy list or durable recovery for configuration modifications, cancellations, subaccounts or funds operations.

Aster enable-trading/signer acceptance, attached strategy editing/whole cancellation, Chase, BBO, Scaled, subaccounts, deposit/withdrawal/transfers, complete valuation and notifications remain incomplete.
BAPI historical statistics and TWAP skipped this phase at user request.
